title: Unit Class
description: A combat category that attackers are more or less effective against.

replace.description: Replace an existing definition with this id.

air.description: Flies: ignores cover and high ground both ways, and shares a cell with one ground unit.

squadSize.description: The most members one squad of this class has in a Battle: a Unit Slot with more fights as several squads. Defaults to no limit, one squad per Unit Slot.

taskForceRole.description: Its part in a Battle AI Task Force: lead (goes in first, ahead of the rest), follow (keeps behind the leaders) or hunt (goes for enemies it fights at a better tier than the rest of the force). Defaults to follow.
